summary: Phase 30 Field Memory retest after _actor_meta fix. 34/34 tests PASS (live integration 23/23 + parity-lock 11/11). The backend fix in /app/backend/routes/field_memory.py::_actor_meta (read actor['_actor'] first, alias 'fl'/'leadership' -> 'field_leadership') is verified correct. NOTE: live role-matrix tests required a test-side patch — conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token on every request, which made _require_any_portal_token short-circuit to the admin path before evaluating X-Dispatch/Shop/FL/HR tokens. Each role-matrix test now explicitly nulls out X-Admin-Token via headers={'X-Admin-Token': '', ...} to bypass the auto-injection. With that adjustment, every assertion in TestRoleMatrix now flips green and captured_by_role correctly returns the portal kind slug.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED FIX: _actor_meta now reads actor['_actor'] first (portal kind slug), falls back to actor['role'] for unit-test compat, and aliases 'fl'/'leadership' -> 'field_leadership'. Live captured_by_role values now equal 'dispatch' / 'shop' / 'field_leadership' as required.

INFRA NOTE (not a backend bug): tests/conftest.py monkey-patches requests.{api,sessions} to setdefault X-Admin-Token on any URL starting with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. This is fine for admin-only suites, but any future test that needs to exercise a non-admin portal token MUST explicitly pass X-Admin-Token='' (setdefault won't overwrite an explicit empty string). Consider documenting this in conftest.py or adding a helper fixture like `non_admin_headers(extra)` to make this pitfall harder to hit.

GOOD: append-only doctrine holds — DELETE /api/field-memory/{id} returns 405/404 as expected; double-resolve returns 400; resolve of missing id returns 404; empty body / invalid subject_kind / invalid resolve reason all return 400.

GOOD: Phase 28/29 regression endpoints all green — /api/admin-strict/diag/persistence-health (200 admin, 401/403 anon), /api/admin/operational-attachments/storage-summary (200), /api/admin-strict/stability/sweep?dry_run=true (200), /api/dispatch/operational-moments/by-assignment/{id} (reachable, no auth regression).

GOOD: 'fl' portal kind from per-user FL accounts (iter314) and 'leadership' from shared-password gate both correctly alias to 'field_leadership' in the write matrix — confirmed by test_fl_can_write_project asserting captured_by_role == 'field_leadership'.
